name: KRN Heat Exchanger and Refrigeration Limited
summary: KRN Heat Exchanger and Refrigeration Limited manufactures and sells heating ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) parts and accessories in India and internationally. It offers condenser, chilled water, evaporator, floating type, fluid and steam, heating, sea water, and Ss coils; charge air, combi oil, converter offline oil, oil, transformer oil, water coolers, and radiators; refrigerator components, such as frost free evaporator, skin condenser, roll bond evaporator, wire on tube condenser, and aluminum tube; and complete HVAC systems, including adiabatic coolers, dry coolers, and LT-HT remote radiators.
